properties.displayName: SCF - Manual attestation for application using hashing and encryption during transit and storage.
properties.description: This policy requires manual attestation to confirm the enforcement of measures that apply technical safeguards (e.g., hashing, checksums, database integrity constraints) to detect and prevent data corruption or manipulation.
